title: IBM security advisory (AV26-1022)
description: As of October 8, 2026, IBM is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
IBM DataPower Gateway 10.5.0
	Prior to or equal to 10.5.0.22

IBM DataPower Gateway 10.6.0
	Prior to or equal to 10.6.0.10

IBM DataPower Gateway 10.6CD
	Prior to or equal to 10.6.6

IBM DataPower Gateway 11.0.0
	Prior to or equal to 11.0.0.2
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
